judge_claim: An iterative bisection search over the squeezing parameter R (relating the physical and reference bases via a Bogoliubov transformation) converges in O(log(1/epsilon_R)) iterations for first-quantization Hamiltonian learning (Section 5.3, Eq. 77-78).

domain.inner_oracle: finite-Fock displacement and number twirl, sampled X/Y robust phase estimation, angular contrast recovery

assumptions: the initial interval brackets the physical squeezing parameter
g'20 is known to vanish in the physical basis
the signal is continuous and has nonzero derivative at Delta R=0
the reference basis satisfies the paper's RPE overlap condition
the calibrated inner D-RUT/RPE oracle resolves the signal sign
exact_statement_tested: With the stated assumptions, after n bisections the bracket width is W/2^n and midpoint error is at most W/2^(n+1), so n=ceil(log2(W/(2 epsilon_R))) is O(log(1/epsilon_R)).
non_circularity: The RPE level is the first empirical success in a predeclared horizon sweep on a disjoint sign-calibration task. Formula-derived inner resources are not the main evidence.
negative_controls: the lowest underpowered RPE level must fail calibration
K=0 gives an identically zero barren-plateau signal with no sign bracket
the historical x^2 proxy has no sign-changing bracket on the tested interval
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if the exact Bogoliubov identity, interval-contraction certificate, overlap/rank assumptions, independent RPE calibration, disjoint validations, independent checker, and controls all pass; otherwise BLOCKED.
